mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals stronger economic demand, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth above trend fails to predict positive SPX returns in at least 60% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC drops below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing output, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as profit margins contract.
failure_condition: If INDPRO weakness fails to predict negative SPX returns in at least 55% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year window.
